endorsements.name: George Hughey
endorsements.label: An Insider's Perspective on Integer Overflow Vulnerabilities
endorsements.description: Challenges and Solutions from Identification to Mitigation at Microsoft This talk will delve deep into one of the most prevalent memory safety issues on Windows: Integer Overflows.  Over the past few years, MSRC has seen hundreds of Integer Overflow vulnerabilities, ranging from size overflows, integer truncations, overflows in checks, and reference counting overflows. We will cover the differences between these categories and investigate common pitfalls about the vulnerability root causes and their fixes.
endorsements.subtitle: CanSecWest 2023

endorsements.name: George Hughey
endorsements.label: Rolling in the Dough: How Microsoft Identified and Remediated a Baker’s Dozen of Security Threats in the Windows DNS Server
endorsements.description: This talk is a collaboration between the team who identified several vulnerabilities in the Windows DNS Server and the team who fixed them. As a security researcher in the Microsoft Security Response Center, George will discuss the motivations behind exploring this attack surface, the prior research that inspired this work, and the significance of this attack surface for future researchers.
